goal: Prepare a reusable, source-cited materials note for the pedestrian access section of the fictional Cedar maintenance report. Cover only access arrangements, timing and limits; do not design new safety measures or resolve conflicting sources.

sources.title: Synthetic project brief
sources.content: Fictional Cedar maintenance project. The report compiles supplied access arrangements, not structural assessment. Construction calculations are outside scope.

sources.title: Synthetic access arrangements
sources.content: From 08:00 to 17:00, pedestrians use the east footpath. The west footpath is closed during maintenance. These arrangements apply to the maintenance week only.

sources.title: Synthetic operational notice
sources.content: Outside 08:00 to 17:00, this notice does not establish the pedestrian access arrangement. Do not infer a night-time route from the daytime arrangement.

existing_artifacts.title: Cedar access materials note
existing_artifacts.body: During the maintenance week from 08:00 to 17:00, pedestrians use the east footpath; the west footpath is closed [access]. No night-time arrangement is established by these sources [notice]. The scope is compilation of supplied access arrangements, not structural assessment or new design [brief].
